findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure network usage in tools (urllib/urllib2 without TLS verification)
 * @description Find uses of urllib/urllib2 in tools scripts that may perform insecure HTTP requests
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pyasn1-modules/insecure-network-tools
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-319
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from API::CallNode call, File f
where
  f = call.getLocation().getFile() and
  f.getRelativePath().matches("tools/%") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potential insecure network request in tools script (no TLS verification by default)."
findings.hypothesis: Tools scripts may use urllib/urllib2 over HTTP without TLS verification, exposing sensitive data in transit.

message.text: Potential insecure network request in tools script (no TLS verification by default).
